title: Understanding Linear Models
text: A linear model is one where the parameters (like theta) appear linearly. This means they are not multiplied together, raised to a power, or involved in any non-linear operations.

title: Identifying Linear Models
text: Check if the model can be expressed in the form of a linear combination of parameters. If the parameters are only multiplied by constants or variables, it is linear.

title: Analyzing the Given Model
text: Consider the model \( $$\hat{y}=\theta_0+\theta_{0theta,1} x_1$$ \). Is this a linear model with respect to \( $$\theta$$ \)?
